name: Ask {alias}
welcome: Hey! I’m {name}’s portfolio assistant. I can help you explore his work, skills, and broadcast experience. What would you like to know?
disclosure: Quick answers use saved Q&A. Enable on-device AI for natural, context-aware replies.
fallback: I don’t have a verified answer to that in {name}’s portfolio yet. You can ask about his projects, skills, experience, or get in touch with him directly.

questions.question: Show me his projects
questions.answer: Explore five featured productions: MR TRIPLE R — 6 Million Special Tournament, RTB Fest 2025, Offline Clash — LQD, T4B × LQD Campus Battle, and MIST Campus Edition. The Projects folder includes 71 production images, plus broadcast links where available.

questions.question: What tools does he use?
questions.answer: His toolkit includes {skills}. Open Skills for more about how these tools support his work.

questions.question: Where has he worked?
questions.answer: His portfolio lists: {experience}. Open Experience for the details.

questions.question: How can I contact him?
questions.answer: For production work or collaboration, email {email}. Share the event dates, broadcast requirements, and scope so {name} can discuss availability and pricing with you. Rates aren’t listed in this portfolio.

questions.question: Can he automate production workflows?
questions.answer: Yes. His portfolio includes Excel and Google Sheets automation, API workflows, and custom programming for backend production utilities. These support repeatable production tasks and live-event data handling.

questions.answer: Free Fire esports is a core focus of his broadcast work. Portfolio highlights: {stats}. {bio}

questions.answer: You can find {name} on these profiles: {social_links}. All links are also in the Contact window.

questions.answer: Hey! Great to have you here. Ask me about {name}’s esports productions, his experience, the tools he uses, or how to get in touch.

questions.answer: You’re welcome! Feel free to explore the desktop or ask me another question about {name}’s work.
